# Tender response — Framework agreement for technical property maintenance (JMK-TEK-2026/09)

Visakoivu Oy

## About Visakoivu Oy

Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services company based in Jyvaskyla, active across HVAC, electrical, building automation and property maintenance. Among our specialisations is a dedicated data-centre cooling specialisation unit, giving us particular depth in refrigeration and precision air-conditioning work.

## Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy has completed reference projects meeting both value thresholds set out in Section 3. Our equity ratio, per our most recent financial statements, is well above the 20% threshold in Section 3.4.

## Technical response

**Fault response and standby.** Visakoivu operates a standby arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays, with defined response-time commitments for reported faults at any of the four properties.

**Access control and site security.** Personnel will observe the contracting authority's access-control and site-security procedures at all four properties, including the school and day-care premises during operating hours, following the site rules given by each property's contact person.

**Environmental matters.** Waste is segregated by type, hazardous substances are handled under our environmental management system, and spill-prevention measures are applied wherever relevant across the properties covered by this agreement.

**Building envelope inspection.** Roof, facade and window condition are inspected twice yearly at each property, with a short written note on condition provided after each round.

## Commercial terms

We propose the standard cost-of-living index as the price adjustment mechanism for the contract term. We accept the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level under Section 4 is not met.

## Forms enclosed

Curricula vitae of key personnel proposed for delivery of the contract; completed Tender Form (Liite 1).

## Format

The tender is submitted as a single PDF file. Prices are exclusive of value-added tax, in euros.

## Annex A — Technical specification

Spare-parts availability and standard delivery times are confirmed for the installed building systems, so that outstanding faults are not left waiting on parts longer than necessary. Fire-protection systems — smoke detection, fire dampers and emergency lighting — are maintained on a defined schedule at each property. Lift maintenance is carried out under the applicable statutory periodic inspection regime, with our arrangements for the periodic inspections described on request.

Visakoivu Oy is well placed to take on this framework agreement given our existing footprint of similar work with municipal and institutional clients in the region, and we look forward to the opportunity to work with Jarvimaan kunta across the contract term and any extension periods that follow.
